matched.description: True only if the listing is a pair of the buyer's exact model. False when different model, different brand, not shoes, box only, kids, bundle, or undeterminable.

semanticScore.description: 0.0 to 1.0. Certainty of model identification plus free-text condition satisfaction. 0.0 when matched is false.

reason.description: One short Korean sentence citing the text relied on.
